notes.title: New grids added in the game thanks to the community!
notes.content:
Hello players!

You have been several to send me words and even grids suggestion for the game in my different channels (Twitter/Discord/Steam...)!

I used this awesome energy to create 12 new grids in the game: 
- 8 in EASY (3x3) in Vacation, Beach, Camping, Ocean themes (2 per theme)
- 4 in MEDIUM (4x4)(1 per theme)

I also listen feedback regarding the existing grids and fix as many flaws as possible:

 Less repeated words.
 Less letter repetition in the same grid.
 Less plural words.
 Association of words in the same grid to have something more coherent.
For example: 
 The first grid for each theme in EASY is now easier.
 The last grid for each theme in EASY is harder.


I also received a lot of suggestion (themes & categories) for the next episode of the series!!!
I can tell you that I already started working on it and it will be available in September! 

I will tell you more about it when I will be more advanced on it, in the meantime, please continue to send me your feedback, ideas & good energy on Twitter or Discord! 

Have a nice summer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41073029/911659144043eb90c37a103fbd54f4b5fe545f71.png

notes.title: Square Word: Summer Edition is now available on Steam (-10%)
notes.content:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/36422902/e847db2ea0ee1e80933ff58dd031eb5d4eabfd85.png

Hello lovers of calm and puzzle games!

After a very long break, we are releasing a new game on Steam! 
Square Word is a word game focused on Summer!

It's our second word game and we listen all the feedback from the previous episode to make it better (the Christmas edition is not available on Steam but we will reboot it for next Christmas!).

What's in it?
- 4 Summer themes!
- More than 120 levels from very easy to very hard.
- Two different hint to help you when you are stuck.
- Daily grid with a single 9-letter word to find
- Mini-objectives to complete

Play now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707670/Square_Word_Summer_Edition/

notes.title: Rogue's Choice is now available!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36422902/a3d6d3f727585abc5548bfde15843c984fccaa48.jpg
Hello players!

Cold Coffee Studio and Delight Games are proud to announce the release of our second game book in the DnD Adventures series: Rogue's Choice!

Play the lovable scoundrel who just wants to enjoy his short time in this dimension!

REMINDER: This story is not connected to Wizard's Choice, you don't need to have played or finish Wizard to play this new adventure! It's the same world but a different location and story. Some elements may remind you WC while playing it but there are just little connections/winks.

What's in the menu:
- A longer (and harder) story divided in 22 chapters!
- No more magic for you this time but you have different skills!
- A brand new intro :)
- New backgrounds, new FX, new songs, colors and everything. We improved Wizard UI a lot and those improvements will also come to WC in the upcoming day (after a big round of tests and adaptations).
- New menu to see the other gamebooks available in the series!
- We did a lot of changes according to the feedback we received in WC Steam reviews like

 Shorter screen transitions
 Better "Dark screen filter"
 Musics also transition between scenes, they don't cut anymore.
 Some of you find WC to easy, try this one!
 Size of buttons now increases with size of text, it's easier to read but also easier to click!
 We turned all Ressources into Resources!


We hope that you will really like this new story hand crafted by Delight Games and me!
Join us on Twitter!
https://twitter.com/DelightGames
https://twitter.com/coldcoffeegames
